note: SMAD2 truncating mutations are known to trigger or escape NMD, and dominant-negative mechanisms from NMD escape are an established paradigm in related TGF-beta vasculopathies.

evidence.text: Mutations in SMAD2 and related TGF-beta pathway genes are recognized to result in loss of function via nonsense-mediated mRNA decay.

source.title: Genetics of marfan syndrome and loeys-dietz syndrome
source.quote: of patients with mutations in SMAD2, TGFB2, and TGFB3 … predicted to lead to nonsense-mediated decay, loss of function
